# Copilot instructions

This repository is a classic Angular NgModule application for user management.

- Use existing Angular module-based patterns instead of standalone APIs.
- Keep the service layer responsible for HttpClient calls.
- Preserve the department/user relationship and mock API contract.
- Validate with `npm run build` before finishing work.
- Start the mock API with `npm run mock-api` and the app with `npm start` when testing locally.
- Prefer small, focused changes that match the current structure and naming conventions.
